answer: Require every agent to lock a bond in a public contract, then slash it if auditors prove the same operator created duplicate identities to claim rewards. Auditors check signed activity histories; a cipher can conceal private data while proving eligibility. Each fake persona now needs separate capital and a credible record, so a sybil farm ties up funds and risks losing them. A detected duplicate can create a ripple of lost trust, while a terrace of unrelated users is not punished just for sharing a provider.
